description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between a numerical value on the x-axis and values representing Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Values” and has a linear scale ranging from 5.0 to 25.0 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The line representing Accuracy is blue, marked with circular data points, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.24 at x=5.0 and increases to approximately 0.92 at x=25.0. The line representing Confidence is green, marked with triangular data points, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.78 at x=5.0 and increases to approximately 0.94 at x=25.0. The line representing Alignment is red, marked with square data points, and is dashed. It begins at approximately 0.53 at x=5.0 and increases to approximately 0.81 at x=25.0.
